title: 'Dhurandhar 2's Bite Will Be Toxic': Ram Gopal Varma Takes A Dig At Yash After 'Southies Invasion' Comment? | Bollywood News - News18
text: Ram Gopal Varma hasn’t stopped praising Dhurandhar ever since he watched the film. Now, he has seemingly taken a dig at Yash’s Toxic, which is set to clash with Dhurandhar 2 in 2026. Ranveer Singh’s Dhurandhar has firmly established itself as one of Bollywood’s biggest blockbusters, ensuring that Hindi cinema ends 2025 on an emphatic high. The sequel will return in March this year, clashing with Yash’s highly anticipated film. RGV took to X, formerly known as Twitter, and wrote, “DHURANDHAR 2‘S BITE will be TOXIC." This is not the first time that the filmmaker has taken a dig at South Indian cinema while praising Dhurandhar. RGV took to X on Monday and wrote, “THE FIRE BALL of the SOUTHIES invasion into BOLLYWOOD has been KICKED back by @AdityaDharFilms left foot, named #dhurandhar and now his right foot getting ready with #dhurandhar 2 … From what I saw of the 2nd part, if the 1st SCARED them, the 2nd will TERRIFY them." Meanwhile, Dhuradhar 2 and Toxic are both said to be releasing on March 19. The first film, which opened on December 5, marks one of the most ambitious spy action thrillers India has attempted. Directed, written and co-produced by Aditya Dhar, Dhurandhar features Ranveer Singh in the lead, supported by Sara Arjun, Sanjay Dutt, Arjun Rampal, Akshaye Khanna and R. Madhavan. At 214 minutes, the film stands among the longest Indian titles ever made. Ever since its release, Dhurandhar has maintained a strong momentum at the box office. It has quickly become one of the highest-grossing Hindi films ever made. With this success, the anticipation for Dhurandhar 2 is at an all-time high. As such, the film will give a significant fight to Yash’s Toxic. Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups is an upcoming Indian period gangster drama written by Geetu Mohandas and Yash, with Mohandas also directing the film. Headlined by Yash, the project brings together a star-studded ensemble featuring Nayanthara, Kiara Advani, Tara Sutaria, Huma Qureshi, Rukmini Vasanth, Akshay Oberoi and Sudev Nair. The film is produced by Venkat K. Narayana and Yash under KVN Productions and Monster Mind Creations.
